_comment: Measured 2026-08-04 against the built corpus at plan d5c9bcd38735e1f0, to settle whether the
two diverged image lines' disagreement about families/pretrain.json `distinct_ids_min`
(256 on the reservoir line at 7a97c27, 128 on the vendored line at d08aa05/e0984c8) could
change this corpus's Gate A verdict. It cannot: every bundle's SMALLEST shard clears BOTH.
Method: read Gate A's own sampling window (DECODE_SAMPLE_BYTES=65536 in _N_WINDOWS=4 windows)
from the smallest shard of each of the 27 bundles via ranged GETs, count np.unique, and compare
against the scaled floor min(declared, max(n//4, 2)). The vocab cap is inert here:
_cap_min_distinct_by_vocab returns min(declared, max(16, 100278//16=6267)), so the declared
floor passes through unchanged. Every sampled id was also asserted < vocab 100278.
Smallest shards are the risky ones -- the two ragged tails (finewiki--train 19,529,728 tokens
and ubuntu-irc--train 3,538,944) are where a thin shard would show up first.
result: 0 of 27 bundles fail at either floor; worst-case margin 8.9x over the stricter bound
